get.description: Returns the Clay user and workspace associated with the API key.

get.summary: Fetch progress and results for a batch run
get.description: Returns current status and results for an asynchronous batch routine run.

get.summary: Fetch progress and results for a routine run
get.description: Returns current status and paginated results for an asynchronous routine run.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous routine run for up to 100 input items.

post.summary: Start an async routine run-batch over an uploaded JSONL file
post.description: Starts an asynchronous batch routine run over a previously uploaded JSONL file.

post.summary: Issue a presigned PUT URL for uploading a batch input JSONL
post.description: Creates a presigned URL for uploading a JSONL file used by a batch routine run.

post.summary: Create a search from structured filters
post.description: Starts a new Clay search from a source type and structured filter fields.

get.summary: List the filter fields available for a search source type
get.description: Returns every filter field accepted by POST /search/filters-mode for the given source type, including each field's type, description, allowed values, and usage guidance. Call this before creating a search to build valid filters.

post.summary: Run the search iterator and return the next page of results
post.description: Returns the next page of records for an existing filter-mode search.

post.summary: Create a search from a Clay search query (beta)
post.description: Starts a new Clay search from a Clay advanced search query. The source type is detected from the query and returned in the response. Count-mode and jobs queries are not supported.

get.summary: Get the Clay search query reference (beta)
get.description: Returns the Clay search query reference document (markdown), covering the queryable fields and the query grammar. Use it to author a Clay advanced search query before creating a query-mode search.

post.summary: Run the query-mode iterator and return the next page of results (beta)
post.description: Returns the next page of records for an existing query-mode search.

post.summary: Run a structured query across one or more tables
post.description: Runs a structured query against Clay table data and returns records with field metadata. Results are paginated: pass the returned cursor back to fetch the next page. Scans return rows in least-recently-updated-first order and reflect writes that land while you paginate — a scan returns every record visible when it started and picks up records written while it runs, and a record updated mid-scan can be returned again with fresher data, so deduplicate by id if you need each record once.

truncated.description: True when more results matched than the limit but no cursor can be issued (grouped, aggregated, or custom-ordered queries do not support cursor pagination). Narrow the query or raise the limit to see the rest.

webhook_id.description: ID of a registered Clay webhook to notify when the run finishes.
ID of a registered Clay webhook to notify when the run finishes.

order_by.description: Custom sort. Queries with a custom order_by do not support cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response. Scans page in least-recently-updated-first order and reflect concurrent writes: a record updated mid-scan can be returned again, so deduplicate by id.
